example_zh: 我們尋找精力充沛且積極進取的人才來管理本地客戶支援團隊。

example: Grilled vegetables are a healthy and delicious side dish.
example_zh: 烤蔬菜是健康美味的配菜。

example: All hazardous waste must be disposed of according to strict safety regulations.
example_zh: 所有危險廢棄物必須根據嚴格的安全規定進行處理。

example: Strict regulations govern the safe hazardous waste disposal from chemical and industrial plants.
example_zh: 嚴格的法規規定了化工廠和工業工廠的危險廢棄物如何安全處理。

example: Please do not litter in the park and use the designated waste bins instead.
example_zh: 請不要在公園亂丟垃圾，改用指定的垃圾桶。

example: The improvements in efficiency have resulted in a marginal decrease in costs.
example_zh: 效率提升帶來了邊際成本的下降。

example: Consumer behavior can often be explained by the principle of diminishing marginal utility.
example_zh: 消費者行為通常可以用邊際效用遞減原理來解釋。

example: The company is focusing on market penetration to increase its share of the domestic market.
example_zh: 公司專注於市場滲透以增加國內市場佔有率。

example: Please remove all metal objects from your pockets before passing through the metal detector.
example_zh: 通過金屬探測器前請取出口袋中所有金屬物品。

example: Reaching one million users was a significant milestone for the company.
example_zh: 達到百萬用戶是公司的重要里程碑。

example: This street is for pedestrians only; no cars are allowed.
example_zh: 這條街只限行人通行，不允許汽車進入。

example: We conducted a penetration test to identify any security weaknesses in our external network.
example_zh: 我們進行了滲透測試以識別外部網絡的任何安全漏洞。

example: You should always be respectful when you are visiting a religious site.
example_zh: 造訪宗教聖地時應該保持尊重。

example: The marketing team is using several different tactics to reach their target audience.
example_zh: 行銷團隊採用多種戰術來觸及目標客群。

example: The movie depicts a world struggling to survive after a global nuclear apocalypse.
example_zh: 這部電影描繪了全球核災難後一個苦苦掙扎的世界。

example: The hospital has a special unit for provide intensive care to premature babies.
example_zh: 醫院設有特殊部門為早產嬰兒提供加強護理。

example: Please listen carefully to the announcements for information about your flight.
example_zh: 請仔細聽取關於您航班的廣播通知。

meaning: 學徒, 實習生, 當學徒
example: The vocational school offers an apprentice program that combines classroom learning with on-the-job training.
example_zh: 職業學校提供結合課堂學習和實地訓練的學徒計畫。

example: The initial survey provided a baseline for measuring the impact of the new training program.
example_zh: 初期調查為測量新訓練計畫的影響提供了基準。

example: The company is working hard to be more responsive to customer feedback.
example_zh: 公司正努力更積極地回應客戶意見。

example: The new luxury hotel is located on one of the city's most famous boulevards.
example_zh: 新的豪華飯店位於城市最著名的林蔭大道之一。

example: The training manual is designed to help new staff comprehend the complex procedures.
example_zh: 訓練手冊旨在幫助新員工理解複雜的程序。

example: Attendance at the annual safety training workshop is compulsory for all staff members.
example_zh: 全體員工必須參加年度安全訓練工作坊。

example: In some cases, the government may issue a compulsory license for a life-saving drug during a public health crisis.
example_zh: 在公共衛生危機期間，政府可能會發放強制授權許可證以供救命藥物使用。

example: Rigorous safety measures are in place to prevent any contamination of the chemical manufacturing facility.
example_zh: 化工廠實施了嚴格的安全措施以防止任何汙染。

example: The CEO met with his counterpart from the rival firm to discuss a potential merger.
example_zh: 執行長與競爭對手公司的對應人選會面討論可能的合併。

meaning: 委派, 授權, 代表
example: Effective managers know how to delegate tasks to their team members appropriately.
example_zh: 高效的經理知道如何適當地將任務分配給團隊成員。

example: The firm plans to deploy its latest security software across all its regional offices by the end of the year.
example_zh: 公司計畫在年底前在所有地區辦事處部署最新的安全軟體。

example: Please let us know if you have any special dietary requirements.
example_zh: 如有任何特殊飲食需求，請告知我們。

example: The firm is investing in new technology to reduce its annual carbon emissions and environmental impact.
example_zh: 公司投資新技術以減少年度碳排放和環境影響。

example: The CEO stood by the window and gazed out at the city skyline while he waited.
example_zh: 執行長站在窗邊，邊等待邊凝視著城市天際線。

example: I really need a haircut before the party.
example_zh: 參加派對前我真的需要理一次頭髮。

example: The machines have been sitting idle since the factory closed down.
example_zh: 自從工廠關閉以來，機器一直閒置著。

example: The ripe peach was incredibly sweet and juicy.
example_zh: 成熟的桃子甜度極高又多汁。

example: The final decision on the merger lies with the board of directors.
example_zh: 關於合併的最終決定權在董事會。

example: The turn of the millennium saw a significant increase in the use of digital technology.
example_zh: 千禧年的到來見證了數位技術使用的顯著增長。

example: There is a significant overlap in the responsibilities of the marketing and sales departments.
example_zh: 行銷部門和銷售部門的職責有顯著的重疊。

example: Our sales representative will pay a visit to your office tomorrow afternoon.
example_zh: 我們的銷售代表明天下午將到您的辦公室進行拜訪。

example: The local market is famous for its beautiful handmade pottery.
example_zh: 當地市場以精美的手工陶器而聞名。

example: I can recommend her for the position without reservation based on her excellent performance.
example_zh: 基於她的優異表現，我可以毫無保留地推薦她擔任該職位。

example: He applied for a residency permit so he could live and work in the country long-term.
example_zh: 他申請了居留許可證以便能長期在該國生活和工作。

example: With responsive design, our website looks great on all devices, from desktops to smartphones.
example_zh: 透過響應式設計，我們的網站在所有設備上都表現出色。

meaning: 與某人分手；與某人斷絕關係
example: After several years of partnership, the two companies decided to split up.
example_zh: 經過多年的合作，兩家公司決定分手。

example: The company threatened to take legal action against the competitor for trademark infringement.
example_zh: 公司威脅要對競爭對手提起法律訴訟以進行商標侵權。

example: The company decided to take its former partner to court for trademark infringement.
example_zh: 公司決定對其前合作夥伴提起訴訟以進行商標侵權。

example: A qualified technician was called in to repair the broken air conditioning unit in the office.
example_zh: 辦公室請來了合格的技術人員修理壞掉的空調。

meaning: 成績單, 抄本, 錄音文本
example: Applicants are required to submit an official academic transcript along with their resume.
example_zh: 申請者必須連同履歷表一起提交官方學業成績單。

example: The legal team is checking the validity of the contract before it is signed.
example_zh: 法務團隊在簽署合約前檢查其有效性。

example: The system performs automatic verification of all incoming data to ensure accuracy.
example_zh: 系統自動驗證所有傳入數據以確保準確性。

example: The security team discovered a critical vulnerability in the server software and immediately issued a patch.
example_zh: 安全團隊發現了伺服器軟體中的嚴重漏洞並立即發布修補程式。

example: The vulnerability assessment identified several critical security issues that need to be addressed immediately.
example_zh: 漏洞評估發現了幾個需要立即解決的嚴重安全問題。

example: Winning the 'Exporter of the Year' award was a significant accomplishment for our small marketing firm.
example_zh: 贏得「年度出口商」獎項對我們的小型行銷公司是重大成就。

example: The success of the project is contingent on the approval of the new budget.
example_zh: 項目的成功取決於新預算的批准。

example: The flight attendant will be serving hot and cold beverages shortly.
example_zh: 空服員即將供應熱飲和冷飲。

example: High-speed broadband is essential for smooth video conferencing and data-intensive tasks.
example_zh: 高速寬頻對於順暢的視訊會議和資料密集工作至關重要。

example: The approval of the loan is contingent on the company providing more financial data.
example_zh: 貸款的批准取決於公司提供更多財務數據。

example: The final approval of the merger is contingent upon the results of the regulatory review.
example_zh: 合併的最終批准取決於監管審查的結果。

example: The diplomat worked hard to negotiate a peace agreement between the two countries.
example_zh: 外交官努力促成兩國之間的和平協議談判。

example: The manager emphasized the importance of teamwork in his weekly address.
example_zh: 經理在每週的例會中強調了團隊合作的重要性。

meaning: 後果；副作用；放射性塵埃
example: The company is still dealing with the political fallout from its controversial expansion plans.
example_zh: 公司仍在處理其有爭議性擴展計畫帶來的政治後果。

example: The board approved a 'poison pill' strategy to defend the company against a hostile takeover attempt.
example_zh: 董事會批准了「毒丸」戰略以保護公司免受敵意收購。

example: I like to put a bit of spicy mustard on my hot dog.
example_zh: 我喜歡在熱狗上放一點辛辣的芥末。

example: He described the beauty of the mountain landscape in very poetic language.
example_zh: 他用非常優美的語言描述了山地風景的美。

example: It took several hours to retrieve the lost data from the computer system.
example_zh: 從電腦系統中恢復丟失的數據花了幾個小時。

example: There is still a social stigma attached to mental illness in many cultures.
example_zh: 在許多文化中，精神疾病仍然帶有社會汙名。

example: Patience is a very important trait for a teacher to have.
example_zh: 耐心是教師應具備的重要特質。

example: We should not underestimate the impact of the new regulations on our international operations.
example_zh: 我們不應低估新法規對我們國際營運的影響。

example: The marketing team developed several user personas to better understand their target audience.
example_zh: 行銷團隊開發了幾個使用者角色來更好地理解目標受眾。

meaning: 稱重；權衡(第三人稱單數)
example: The manager carefully weighs all the pros and cons before making a decision.
example_zh: 經理在做決定前仔細權衡所有利弊。

example: The system uses an API to exchange data with external services.
example_zh: 系統使用 API 與外部服務交換數據。

example: The worker was bending over to pick up the heavy box from the floor.
example_zh: 工人彎腰從地上拿起重箱子。

example: Boiled potatoes are a simple but versatile ingredient.
example_zh: 水煮馬鈴薯是簡單但用途廣泛的食材。

example: The pharmaceutical company presented robust data on the clinical efficacy of its new antiviral drug.
example_zh: 藥廠發表了新抗病毒藥物的臨床療效堅實數據。

example: The new office building includes several communal areas where employees from different teams can interact and collaborate.
example_zh: 新辦公大樓包含多個公共區域，供不同團隊的員工互動與協作。

meaning: 財團, 聯盟, 協會
example: A consortium of international banks provided the funding for the new infrastructure project.
example_zh: 一個國際銀行聯盟為新基礎設施計畫提供融資。

example: The legal documents were sent via express courier to ensure next-day delivery.
example_zh: 法律文件透過快遞服務寄送以確保隔日送達。

example: The customer returned the product because of a manufacturing defect in the battery.
example_zh: 顧客因為電池製造缺陷退回了產品。

example: New training programs helped to significantly reduce the defect rate in the assembly line.
example_zh: 新訓練計畫有助於大幅降低組裝線上的缺陷率。

example: These outdoor furniture pieces are made from highly durable materials that resist weathering.
example_zh: 這些戶外傢俱採用高度耐久的材料製造，能抵抗風吹日曬。

example: Clinical trials are currently being conducted to test the efficacy of the new pharmaceutical drug.
example_zh: 臨床試驗正在進行以測試新藥物的療效。

example: The ship's manifest lists all the cargo, passengers, and crew on board.
example_zh: 船舶清單列出船上的所有貨物、乘客和船員。

example: The new software includes an easy-to-use interface that helps users navigate the system.
example_zh: 新軟體包含易於使用的介面，幫助使用者瀏覽系統。

meaning: 擴大服務範圍；外展活動
example: The company's community outreach program provides funding for local schools.
example_zh: 公司的社區外展計畫為當地學校提供資金。

example: The procurement department is responsible for selecting and managing all company vendors.
example_zh: 採購部門負責選擇和管理所有公司供應商。

example: A transparent procurement process is essential for ensuring fairness and value for money.
example_zh: 透明的採購流程對於確保公平和物有所值至關重要。

example: The training session was designed to reinforce the importance of workplace safety.
example_zh: 訓練課程旨在強化工作場所安全的重要性。

example: The company's new marketing strategy is expected to revive its declining sales.
example_zh: 公司的新行銷策略預計將振興其下降的銷售。

example: All new products must undergo rigorous safety testing before they are released to the public.
example_zh: 所有新產品在向公眾發布前必須進行嚴格的安全測試。

example: Many experts remained skeptical about the company's claims of a breakthrough technology.
example_zh: 許多專家對公司聲稱的突破性技術持懷疑態度。

example: The university is managed by a board of trustees consisting of prominent community leaders.
example_zh: 大學由傑出社區領袖組成的受託人委員會管理。

example: There was a very high turnout at the annual general meeting this year.
example_zh: 今年年度股東大會的出席率非常高。

example: The board of directors reached a unanimous decision to appoint the new CEO.
example_zh: 董事會一致同意任命新執行長。

example: Thorough validation of the software is required before it can be released to customers.
example_zh: 軟體必須經過徹底的驗證才能發布給客戶。

meaning: 令人驚訝的, 驚人的
example: The company has seen astonishing growth in its overseas sales over the past three fiscal years.
example_zh: 過去三個會計年度，公司海外銷售實現了驚人的增長。

example: The smell of fresh bread from the bakery is wonderful.
example_zh: 烘焙坊傳來的新鮮麵包香氣令人陶醉。

example: The tech giant has pledged to achieve carbon neutrality across its entire supply chain by 2030.
example_zh: 科技巨擘承諾到2030年在其整個供應鏈中達到碳中和。

example: The report cites several successful case studies to support its recommendations.
example_zh: 報告引用了幾個成功案例來支持其建議。

meaning: 時事評論員, 廣播解說員
example: The financial commentator suggested that the central bank might raise interest rates later this year.
example_zh: 金融評論員建議央行今年稍後可能會升息。

example: The train is scheduled to depart from platform five in ten minutes.
example_zh: 列車預定在十分鐘後從五號月臺出發。

example: Implementing e-procurement has streamlined our purchasing process and reduced administrative costs.
example_zh: 實施電子採購簡化了我們的採購流程並降低了行政成本。

example: The classic design of the car has an enduring appeal for many collectors.
example_zh: 這輛車的經典設計對許多收藏家有著經久不衰的吸引力。

example: The company held a magnificent gala dinner to celebrate its twentieth anniversary.
example_zh: 公司舉辦了盛大的慶功宴來慶祝其二十週年紀念。

example: He spends most of his weekends gardening in his backyard.
example_zh: 他大多數週末都在後花園裡從事園藝工作。

example: We usually go to the supermarket to buy our weekly groceries on Saturdays.
example_zh: 我們通常在週六去超市採購每週的雜貨。

example: The airline's inaugural flight to London will take place next Wednesday.
example_zh: 航空公司前往倫敦的首航將在下週三舉行。

example: The marketing department is looking for an intern to help with social media.
example_zh: 行銷部門正在徵求實習生幫助管理社群媒體。

example: It usually takes me a few days to recover from jet lag after a long international flight.
example_zh: 長途國際飛行後，我通常需要幾天才能恢復時差。

example: The electrician is busy installing new energy-efficient light fixtures in the office.
example_zh: 電工正在辦公室安裝新的節能燈具。

example: The security system is designed to detect and block any malicious attacks on the network.
example_zh: 安全系統旨在偵測並阻止網路上的任何惡意攻擊。

example: The concept of monetary neutrality suggests that changes in the money supply only affect nominal, not real, variables in the long run.
example_zh: 貨幣中立性的概念表明，從長期看，貨幣供應量的變化隻影響名義變數而不影響實際變數。

example: The company is on the verge of signing a major contract with an international client.
example_zh: 公司即將與一個國際客戶簽署重大合約。

example: The courier delivered a large parcel containing the office supplies this morning.
example_zh: 信使今早送達了一個包含辦公用品的大包裹。

example: The machine was making a peculiar noise, so we called the maintenance team to check it.
example_zh: 機器發出奇怪的噪音，所以我們請維修團隊檢查。

example: All employees must sign an agreement to protect the company's proprietary information.
example_zh: 所有員工必須簽署協議以保護公司的專有資訊。

example: We took the scenic route through the mountains instead of the highway.
example_zh: 我們走了穿過山區的風景優美路線，而不是走高速公路。

example: We decided to take the scenic route through the mountains instead of the faster highway.
example_zh: 我們決定走穿過山區的風景優美路線，而不是走速度更快的高速公路。

meaning: 易受影響的；易受感染的
example: Children and the elderly are more susceptible to certain types of respiratory diseases.
example_zh: 兒童和老年人更容易患上某些呼吸道疾病。

meaning: 充滿活力的；響亮的；鮮豔的
example: The city center has a vibrant atmosphere with many shops, cafes, and theaters.
example_zh: 市中心充滿活力，有許多商店、咖啡館和劇院。

example: We spent the afternoon wandering about the historic city center.
example_zh: 我們整個下午在歷史悠久的市中心漫步。

example: The company plans to accelerate its digital transformation to keep up with the evolving market trends.
example_zh: 公司計畫加快數位轉型以跟上不斷變化的市場趨勢。

example: The manager decided to assign the project to the most experienced members of the team.
example_zh: 經理決定將專案分配給團隊中經驗最豐富的成員。

example: Blockchain technology provides a secure and transparent way to record financial transactions.
example_zh: 區塊鏈技術提供了一種安全透明的方式來記錄金融交易。

example: Blockchain technology provides a secure and transparent way to record supply chain transactions.
example_zh: 區塊鏈技術提供了一種安全透明的方式來記錄供應鏈交易。

example: Due to unforeseen circumstances, we have been forced to postpone the conference until further notice.
example_zh: 由於不可預見的情況，我們被迫延期會議直到另行通知。

example: He used his house as collateral to secure a loan for his new business venture.
example_zh: 他用房子作為抵押品為新業務融資。

example: The company is looking for alternative routes to avoid the severe traffic congestion in the city center.
example_zh: 公司正在尋找替代路線以避免市中心的嚴重交通堵塞。

example: During the credit crunch, banks became very reluctant to lend money, even to reputable companies.
example_zh: 在信貸危機期間，銀行變得非常不願意借錢，即使是給信譽良好的公司。

meaning: 嘎吱地咬；計算(大量數據)；緊縮
example: The accountants spent the whole day crunching numbers for the annual financial report.
example_zh: 會計師整天都在計算年度財務報告的數字。

meaning: 倒閉, 死亡, 轉讓
example: The rapid advancement of digital technology led to the eventual demise of many traditional film-based firms.
example_zh: 數位技術的快速發展最終導致許多傳統膠片企業的倒閉。

example: Our heavy dependence on a single supplier for raw materials is a significant risk to our operations.
example_zh: 我們對單一原材料供應商的過度依賴是對我們業務的重大風險。

example: Despite their disagreement on some issues, they remained good friends.
example_zh: 儘管他們在某些問題上有分歧，但仍然保持著良好的友誼。

example: Please disregard the previous email as it contained some incorrect information.
example_zh: 請忽略前一封電子郵件，因為它包含一些不正確的資訊。

example: The company appointed a new distributor for the Asian market.
example_zh: 公司為亞洲市場任命了新的經銷商。

example: He made an earnest attempt to resolve the conflict between the two departments.
example_zh: 他真誠地努力解決兩個部門之間的衝突。

example: His immature comments during the meeting were seen as unprofessional by the manager.
example_zh: 他在會議中的幼稚評論被經理視為不專業。

example: It is imperative that we complete the project before the deadline.
example_zh: 我們必須在截止日期前完成專案。

example: She is currently on maternity leave and will return to work next month.
example_zh: 她目前在育嬰假中，下個月將返回工作。

example: The team's morale has improved significantly since the successful launch of the product.
example_zh: 自產品成功發布以來，團隊的士氣有了明顯提高。

example: We are constantly looking for ways to improve the optimization of our logistics network.
example_zh: 我們不斷尋找方法來改進物流網路的最佳化。

example: The manager made several interesting remarks about the new project during the meeting.
example_zh: 經理在會議中就新專案發表了幾項有趣的評論。

example: By implementing SEO best practices, we were able to improve our organic search rankings.
example_zh: 透過實施搜尋引擎最佳化最佳實踐，我們能夠改進有機搜尋排名。

example: The new product design was kept under a veil of secrecy until the official launch.
example_zh: 新產品設計在正式發布前一直保持機密。

meaning: 多才多藝的, 多功能的
example: We are looking for a versatile individual who can handle both administrative and marketing tasks.
example_zh: 我們正在尋找一位能夠處理行政和行銷任務的多才多藝的人。

example: Investors are cautioned about the high risks associated with trading complex financial derivatives in the market.
example_zh: 投資者被告知交易複雜金融衍生品的高風險。

example: The price of the product has been drastically reduced to attract more customers.
example_zh: 產品價格已大幅降低以吸引更多客戶。

example: The workload was evenly distributed among all the members of the team.
example_zh: 工作量在團隊所有成員之間均勻分配。

example: Certain types of equipment are eligible for a tax exemption under the new trade agreement.
example_zh: 某些設備類型根據新貿易協議符合稅收豁免資格。

example: The office building is connected to the internet via a high-speed fiber optic cable.
example_zh: 辦公樓透過高速光纖連接到網際網路。

example: The proposal was narrowly approved by the board of directors after a long discussion.
example_zh: 該提案在長時間討論後以微弱多數獲得董事會批准。

example: The accident was caused by the gross negligence of the construction supervisor.
example_zh: 事故是由建築主管的重大過失造成的。

example: The old computer system has become obsolete and needs to be replaced immediately.
example_zh: 舊電腦系統已過時，需要立即更換。

example: The company is trying to salvage what it can from the failed merger.
example_zh: 該公司正試圖從失敗的合併中補救能挽救的部分。

example: We would like to thank you for your speedy response to our inquiry.
example_zh: 感謝您快速回應我們的詢問。

example: The staging of the new musical was absolutely spectacular and received great reviews.
example_zh: 新音樂劇的製作演出精彩絕倫，獲得極佳評價。

example: The new features are thoroughly tested in a staging environment before being deployed to production.
example_zh: 新功能在預備環境中徹底測試後才部署到正式環境。

example: The manager's persuasive arguments were able to sway the board's decision.
example_zh: 經理說服力十足的論點能夠影響董事會的決定。

example: The non-profit organization applied for a tax exemption status from the local government.
example_zh: 非營利組織向地方政府申請稅務豁免身份。

example: The company has the right to terminate the agreement if the terms are not met by the client.
example_zh: 若客戶未履行條款，公司有權終止協議。

example: Constant criticism from management can seriously undermine employee morale.
example_zh: 管理層的持續批評會嚴重打擊員工士氣。

meaning: 空缺, 職缺, 空房
example: There is currently a vacancy for a senior accountant in our financial department.
example_zh: 本公司財務部目前招聘一名資深會計師。

example: The CEO has the power to veto any decision made by the regional managers.
example_zh: CEO 有權否決地區經理的任何決定。

meaning: 職業的, 職業技術的
example: The government is increasing funding for vocational training programs to help reduce unemployment.
example_zh: 政府增加職業訓練計畫的經費以幫助減少失業。

example: The new building was designed to withstand even the most severe earthquakes.
example_zh: 新建築設計可承受最嚴重的地震。

example: New employees often take a few weeks to become accustomed to the company's internal software systems.
example_zh: 新員工通常需要幾週時間才能適應公司內部軟體系統。

example: All qualified applicants will be contacted for an initial phone interview within the next two weeks.
example_zh: 所有合格申請人將在未來兩週內獲邀進行初步電話面試。
